subject: mirtCAT - multiple connections issue when hosting on Rstudio-Connect

messages.author: cd0ebcb57b88c479
messages.subject: mirtCAT - multiple connections issue when hosting on Rstudio-Connect
parts:
Hi Phil and all,
My research group has been trying to host a mirtCAT object on the Rstudio-Connect server.
One thing we encountered but didn't yet figure out why is that the deployed app keeps crashed when multiple users access this survey(or test) simultaneously.

I went over the section 'Public hosting) in the mirtCAT wiki page but didn't find answers.
I wonder if anyone has had similar issues or understand how to solve this.

Thanks,
Jungmin

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: mirtCAT - multiple connections issue when hosting on Rstudio-Connect
parts:
Hi Jungmin,

This sounds like an issue that was reported by another user earlier. Try installing the dev version of mirtCAT from Github on your server first via 

devtools::install_github('philchalmers/mirtCAT')

This newer version allows for unique applications to be run in the same R session. Just be warned that running too many sessions on the same server will at some point slow down the interfaces. HTH.

Phil

messages.author: cd0ebcb57b88c479
messages.subject: Re: mirtCAT - multiple connections issue when hosting on Rstudio-Connect
parts:
Hi Phill,

I've got a new issue since I tried to install the developer version on the Rstudio-Connect server. I'll share the response from the administrator below but In summarizing, the server I am supposed to use is compatible with gsl version 1.15 whereas the recent mirtCAT from github requires gsl v2.
I wonder if is possible for you to provide us a sort of intermediate version of the compiler that is not only compatible with the older version of gsl, but also solves the multiple connection issues when the mirtCAT interface is deployed on the server.
Any suggestion or feedback will be appreciated.

Thanks,
Jungmin

*Below is the message that I got from the administrator who is in charge of Rstudio-Connect in my university.
----------------------------------------
'Hi Jungmin,

Good to hear from you.

I looked at the application logs and it appears the gsl package configuration is failing.

I found this issue that indicates that the configuration arguments may have changed betweeen gsl v1 and v2. It seems that v2 is the supported version - https://github.com/RobinHankin/gsl/issues/4

The gsl and gsl-devel version 1.15 is installed on the server and unfortunately this is the latest version available under RedHat 7. There may be a configuration flag to change to v1 or it may be possible to install gsl v2 alongside v1. I don't want to overwrite v1 for compatibility reasons because it is the OS default. It does appear that RedHat 8 includes gsl v2.5 - upgrading may be an option but we're still finalizing our summer upgrade plans.

You may also want to ask the developer if they have any suggestions. I'd be glad to provide any other details about the library versions available on the server. I will look into the configuration options or the feasibility of also installing gsl version 2 alongside.'

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: mirtCAT - multiple connections issue when hosting on Rstudio-Connect
parts:
Hi Sy-Miin,

mirtCAT does not force any particular gsl version, nor is the requirement for the shiny package particularly high (shiny ≥ 1.0.1). So, you should be able to use an older version of rstudio server to use mirtCAT. I'd contact your IT to see if an older version of the rstudio server can be used instead. That's all I can really recommend at this point since anything gsl related has nothing to do with the code on my end. HTH. 

Phil
